name: migros/search
description: Search Migros for one term by URL. One navigation instead of click-select-type-enter, and it cannot land on the wrong page.

steps.note: MEASURED: migros.com.tr/ is the corporate hub page and has NO search box - only /arama does. Waiting on the title '{product} - Migros' is a real load signal, unlike 'Migros', which every page on the site shares.
Text-only selector, so this is answered from PIXELS - no tree walk. It also stops the next step clicking the previous search's results.
